notes: - **Any cause, not just macro.** Model nodes now cover whatever actually moves the company — supply chains, vendors, energy, raw materials, labor, new products, sales channels, competition, recalls, regulation — with an OPEN category vocabulary instead of a fixed list. The old closed list was forcing real-world causes into whichever bucket fit least badly. - **Causes chain.** Edges may land on another node, not only on a financial driver: `lithium_price → cell_cost → gross_margin_pct`, or `recall → warranty_cost → opex` alongside `recall → brand → revenue growth`. A shock propagates along ever
